Per the 2022 CCXI/中诚信 credit-rating report for 江西省天然气集团有限公司 (http://qxb-pdf-osscache.qixin.com/AnBaseinfo/85599868a5a6e3c2fc8db704da8180b8.pdf, pdftotext -layout extraction hand-confirmed verbatim -- url_verifier flags a false negative on this PDF, it does not parse embedded text; see verification entry), Jiangxi runs TWO separate provincial gas pipeline operators: 江西省天然气管道有限公司 (a 54%/46% JV with 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司/PipeChina) which operates ONLY the Phase I network (川气东送/Sichuan-East-sourced, ~870km, built to 2012, covering Nanchang/Jiujiang/Jingdezhen/Xinyu/Yichun/Fuzhou/Yingtan/Shangrao -- the Poyang Lake economic zone, i.e. every city these five rows sit in); and 江西省天然气集团有限公司管道分公司, an internal division the Group formed independently in early 2016 per provincial-government direction, with NO JV and NO PipeChina stake, which operates Phase II (西气东输二线/WEP2-sourced, ~1,500km across 40 counties). The staged target for all five rows is Owner1=PipeChina 100% (Operator's QCCOwner(业主单位) also targets PipeChina) -- but if these are genuinely WEP2/Phase-II-sourced as their FuelSource target states, the CCXI report says the correct attribution is the Group's own division, with PipeChina holding NO stake at all, not 100%. If instead they are Sichuan-East/Phase-I-sourced (see the pre-existing __VALIDITY__ on P4793/P4794 flagging a StartYear tension with WEP2's actual 2011-09 first-Jiangxi-gas date, now further corroborated: the NDRC's own cross-provincial pipeline tariff table, https://www.ndrc.gov.cn/xxgk/zcfb/tz/202312/P020231205363278799826.pdf, lists 川气东送/Sichuan-East as carrying a documented '江西支线' (Jiangxi branch) among its named branches, distinct from WEP2), the correct owner would be the 54/46 JV, not PipeChina at 100% either. Separately, a live 2025-03-26 Xinhua/上海石油天然气交易中心 article (https://www.shpgx.com/html/xyzx/20250326/7619.html, url_verifier OK) confirms PipeChina's own 西气东输公司南昌输气分公司 (West-East Gas Transmission Co Nanchang Branch) does independently operate a '两干三支' (two mains, three branches) 1335.5km network within Jiangxi as of 2024 -- so a PipeChina stake in SOME Jiangxi gas infrastructure is real, just not proven to be these five named segments specifically, and the CCXI report's Phase II finding says the Group's division runs Phase II with no PipeChina involvement, which appears to conflict with the Nanchang Branch account unless the '两干三支' and the Group's division cover different pipe. I could not resolve which of these three candidate owners (PipeChina 100%, the 54/46 JV, or the Group's own division at ~100%) is correct for these specific segments without a document that names Gao'an-Yujiang/Jiujiang-Gao'an/Linchuan-Lichuan/Yujiang-Jingdezhen/Yujiang-Yingtan individually, which an exhaustive search (document ladder classes 1-7, plus the harvest pool) did not surface. resolutions.researcher_notes: OWNER MISATTRIBUTION RISK -- WEST/EAST SECTION SPLIT. P4947 is staged as the FULL WEP2 trunk (worklist.json confirms StartLocation=Khorgas/Xinjiang through EndPrefecture/District=Guangzhou/Guangdong, 9102km), and the target Owner1 is 'China Petroleum West Pipeline Co Ltd' (中国石油天然气集团西部管道有限责任公司, since 2020 a PipeChina/国家管网集团 subsidiary: 国家管网集团西部管道有限责任公司) at 100%. Targeted search this pass found this company's own scope of operation is documented (company profile pages, investment disclosures) as the WESTERN section of WEP2 only -- Xinjiang Horgos through to the Ningxia Zhongwei hub, which it took over operating from 2009. The EASTERN section beyond Zhongwei -- which is where all five Jiangxi rows in this batch (P4793-P4797) and every other eastern branch sit -- was historically run by a separate entity, 中国石油西气东输管道(销售)有限公司 (West-East Gas Pipeline (Sales) Co), and PipeChina's own live 2025 Nanchang-branch coverage (https://www.shpgx.com/html/xyzx/20250326/7619.html) describes a distinct 西气东输公司南昌输气分公司 as the operating unit within Jiangxi today. I could not find a document that names 'China Petroleum West Pipeline Co Ltd' as owner of the eastern section or of the trunk as a whole -- if the west/east split is real, 100% to the West Pipeline company for a row spanning BOTH sections is geographically incomplete (it should either be split between two owner entities, or attributed to a different holding entity covering the whole trunk post-2020 restructuring, e.g. PipeChina/国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司 itself at the parent level). Leaving Owner UNRESOLVED rather than staging a value my own search casts doubt on; flagging for human adjudication rather than recommending a specific replacement, consistent with 'flag the delta, defer the recommendation.'

resolutions.researcher_notes: OPERATOR/OWNER MISATTRIBUTION RISK, extending batch_03's finding (see shards/batch_03.json and shards/batch_99_crossshard.json, filed on sibling Ganzhou-South rows P4785-P4791/P5860/P5863) to these five rows, which were outside that fan-out's scope. Per the 2022 CCXI/中诚信 credit-rating report for 江西省天然气集团有限公司 (http://qxb-pdf-osscache.qixin.com/AnBaseinfo/85599868a5a6e3c2fc8db704da8180b8.pdf, pdftotext -layout extraction hand-confirmed verbatim -- url_verifier flags a false negative on this PDF, it does not parse embedded text; see verification entry), Jiangxi runs TWO separate provincial gas pipeline operators: 江西省天然气管道有限公司 (a 54%/46% JV with 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司/PipeChina) which operates ONLY the Phase I network (川气东送/Sichuan-East-sourced, ~870km, built to 2012, covering Nanchang/Jiujiang/Jingdezhen/Xinyu/Yichun/Fuzhou/Yingtan/Shangrao -- the Poyang Lake economic zone, i.e. every city these five rows sit in); and 江西省天然气集团有限公司管道分公司, an internal division the Group formed independently in early 2016 per provincial-government direction, with NO JV and NO PipeChina stake, which operates Phase II (西气东输二线/WEP2-sourced, ~1,500km across 40 counties). The staged target for all five rows is Owner1=PipeChina 100% (Operator's QCCOwner(业主单位) also targets PipeChina) -- but if these are genuinely WEP2/Phase-II-sourced as their FuelSource target states, the CCXI report says the correct attribution is the Group's own division, with PipeChina holding NO stake at all, not 100%. If instead they are Sichuan-East/Phase-I-sourced (see the pre-existing __VALIDITY__ on P4793/P4794 flagging a StartYear tension with WEP2's actual 2011-09 first-Jiangxi-gas date, now further corroborated: the NDRC's own cross-provincial pipeline tariff table, https://www.ndrc.gov.cn/xxgk/zcfb/tz/202312/P020231205363278799826.pdf, lists 川气东送/Sichuan-East as carrying a documented '江西支线' (Jiangxi branch) among its named branches, distinct from WEP2), the correct owner would be the 54/46 JV, not PipeChina at 100% either. Separately, a live 2025-03-26 Xinhua/上海石油天然气交易中心 article (https://www.shpgx.com/html/xyzx/20250326/7619.html, url_verifier OK) confirms PipeChina's own 西气东输公司南昌输气分公司 (West-East Gas Transmission Co Nanchang Branch) does independently operate a '两干三支' (two mains, three branches) 1335.5km network within Jiangxi as of 2024 -- so a PipeChina stake in SOME Jiangxi gas infrastructure is real, just not proven to be these five named segments specifically, and the CCXI report's Phase II finding says the Group's division runs Phase II with no PipeChina involvement, which appears to conflict with the Nanchang Branch account unless the '两干三支' and the Group's division cover different pipe. I could not resolve which of these three candidate owners (PipeChina 100%, the 54/46 JV, or the Group's own division at ~100%) is correct for these specific segments without a document that names Gao'an-Yujiang/Jiujiang-Gao'an/Linchuan-Lichuan/Yujiang-Jingdezhen/Yujiang-Yingtan individually, which an exhaustive search (document ladder classes 1-7, plus the harvest pool) did not surface. Leaving Owner and Operator UNRESOLVED rather than staging PipeChina against evidence that at minimum makes it a live three-way question -- this is a candidate for Update/human adjudication, not an auto-applied value. Recommend adjudicating once for the whole P4793-P4797 cohort rather than row by row, same as batch_03/batch_99 recommended for the Ganzhou-South cohort.
